parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Hello, welcome to the annual Community Art Show Information Line. How can I help you today?

Hi, I've already purchased my ticket for the art show, but I wanted to check a few details before the event. Can you help me with that?

Certainly, I'll just need a few details. Can you provide your postcode to find your booking?

Sure, it's AF 741-T.

Thank you. Ah, yes, I've found your booking. Just to confirm you've booked for the 25th of November, right?

Yes, that's correct. What time does the event begin?

The doors open at 4pm, but the actual event starts at 4.30pm. However, we advise arriving early to avoid any delays. By the way, did you know there's a discount for local residents?

Yes, I think I already received it. I'm pretty sure I paid £16.50, right?

Hmm, let me check. Ah, yes, you're right. You paid £16.50 instead of the standard £20.

I'm glad I qualified for the discount. Will my family members be able to come for free as I heard?

That's correct. Family members of local residents can enter free of charge. Just make sure you bring some form of ID that shows your residency.

Excellent. Do you know how many artworks will be on display this year?

Oh, there will be more than 360 pieces from both local and international artists. Last year, we had 320 pieces, but we've expanded the exhibition.

That's impressive. And will there be any special performances this time?

Yes, there's a live sound show that's generating a lot of excitement. It's actually the first time we're including this type of performance.

Oh, a sound performance. I love unique events like that. Now, I also heard there will be live music, right? I believe I read it's going to be guitar music.

Actually, there was an initial plan for guitar music, but it's been changed. Instead, we'll have live piano music, which we think will create a better atmosphere for the event.

That sounds lovely. Now, I'm curious about refreshments. Will there be any available?

Yes, drinks will be sold at the venue, and each ticket holder gets a free drink, either alcoholic or non-alcoholic, depending on your preference. We'll have a selection of beverages available, including water, juices, and wine.

Nice. I'll probably stick to non-alcoholic. I'm bringing my kids along. Are there any special activities for them?

Certainly. We're offering art workshops for children under 12, but please note that parents or guardians must accompany them at all times during the event.

Understood. I'll make sure to keep an eye on them. One last thing. What happens if the event is cancelled? Will we get our money back?

Unfortunately, the tickets are non-refundable, but don't worry. We've taken out an insurance policy for the event. In the event of cancellation, the insurance will cover the cost of your tickets, so you're safe there.

That's good to know. Thanks for all the information.

You're welcome. We look forward to seeing you at the event.

analyses.content: 接线员询问邮编以查询预订信息，男士直接报出了 AF 741-T。
Can you provide your postcode to find your booking? Sure, it's AF 741-T.
注意字母和数字的组合，听到字母分开读时要反应敏捷，连字符通常不计入字数或直接连写。
The doors open at 4pm, but the actual event starts at 4.30pm.
不要听到 4pm 就填，那是 "doors open"（开门）的时间，题目问的是 "Time"（通常指活动正式开始时间）。
接线员澄清说，虽然下午4点开门，但实际活动开始时间是 4.30pm。
I'm pretty sure I paid £16.50, right? Hmm, let me check. Ah, yes, you're right. You paid £16.50 instead of the standard £20.
卷面上已经有了货币符号 £，所以横线上只需要填数字，不要听到 Standard price（20）就填错。
男士确认自己支付了优惠后的价格 16.50 英镑，而不是标准的20英镑。
Will my family members be able to come for free as I heard? That's correct. Family members of local residents can enter free of charge.
题目问的是 "Free entry for ____ members"，听到 "Family members" 时直接锁定 family 即可。
接线员确认，当地居民的 family（家庭）成员可以免费入场。
Oh, there will be more than 360 pieces from both local and international artists. Last year, we had 320 pieces...
不要填 320，录音明确说那是去年的数量（Last year, we had 320...）。
接线员介绍说，今年将有超过 360 件艺术品展出。
关于特别的现场表演，接线员提到有一个现场的 sound（声音）表演正在引起轰动。
Yes, there's a live sound show that's generating a lot of excitement.
题目中已包含 "show"，所以只需要填修饰词 "sound"，不要漏听这个简单的词。
Actually, there was an initial plan for guitar music, but it's been changed. Instead, we'll have live piano music...
典型的“否定干扰”，不要听到 guitar 就填，录音说 "initial plan... but it's been changed"（原计划...但改变了）。
虽然最初计划是吉他，但现在改成了现场 piano（钢琴）音乐。
Yes, drinks will be sold at the venue, and each ticket holder gets a free drink, either alcoholic or non-alcoholic...
不要填 water, juices 或 wine，那些是具体种类的举例，题目需要填概括性名词。
每位持票者都可以获得一杯免费的 drink（饮料），含酒精或不含酒精均可。
对于12岁以下的儿童，必须始终有父母或监护人陪同。
本题还有版本可能要求填 parents 或 guardians。
We're offering art workshops for children under 12, but please note that parents or guardians must accompany them at all times during the event.
In the event of cancellation, the insurance will cover the cost of your tickets, so you're safe there.
不要被 "non-refundable"（不可退款）吓到，题目问的是被什么 "covered by"（覆盖/保障）。
如果活动取消，虽然票不可退，但 insurance（保险）会覆盖票价成本。
